verdicts.reason: A keeps the original composition intact (photo, quote, author box and both quote-mark glyphs in proportion), but it is simply letterboxed: the whole banner sits in the middle with about 110px of dead grey band above and below, so nothing was rearranged for the taller format. B blows the top quote-mark glyph up to a huge size that no longer matches its small partner at the bottom left. It also leaves the quote top-aligned while the photo sits mid-canvas, and drops the author box far below the quote, which opens a big empty gap and breaks the grouping and alignment.
